verification.notes: Confirmed: JM 4325/1795/2630 mm and 325/1375 l (gebrauchtwagenberater, autobild). JM height is 1720-1730 depending on variant. TL width 1850, wheelbase 2670 and trunk 513/1503 are confirmed by autoplenum, autobild and autoscout24. Not confirmed: TL pre-facelift length 4475 and height 1645 were not found verbatim. Third-party sources give 4470-4480 and 1640-1650, so neither value is contradicted. TL Facelift 2.0 CRDi 48V trunk is conflicting. ADAC 48V entries (298956/298957/298961, 04/19-12/20) show 513/1503 l. TopGear and autoscout24.fr show 459 l (and 459-1449). completecar.ie shows 459/1503. The 459 l base value is plausible (battery under the floor), but there is no clear manufacturer source, so no correction is made. Also, ADAC lists 48V models from 04/19, so a variant yearFrom of 2019 could be added. No missing generations: ix35 (2010-2015) is correctly excluded as a separate nameplate.
